brief:
Israeli occupation forces bulldozed and uprooted dozens of olive trees near Hadad village in Jenin city, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition destroyed trees in an area that residents depend on for agricultural livelihoods.

The operation marked another instance of land clearance in the northern West Bank territory, where olive groves have faced repeated destruction during military operations and settlement expansion.
title: Israeli bulldozers uproot dozens of olive trees near Jenin village
